guidance.bestFor: A vertical rail of 5 section buttons in a 150px column to the left of a 500px tall panel
agentNotes: Replace `nav`, which renders both the button rail and the sections; every section body is an empty 350px `bg-muted` block

whenNotToUse.when: Section links laid out in one row above the content

guidance.bestFor: A horizontal row of 5 section buttons above a full width 400px tall panel
agentNotes: `nav` ids run `section-6` to `section-10` under labels Section 1 to 5; sections resolve page wide by `getElementById`, so keep ids unique
The `Scrollspy` row is a flex line with no wrap and its buttons never shrink, so any container narrower than the 5 buttons overflows; let it wrap or scroll

whenNotToUse.when: A narrow column of section links kept beside the content
A bounded panel with overflow but no links that follow the reader
